newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent wipes losses on Yeltsin rumour.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent wipes losses on Yeltsin rumour.

text.p: IPE Brent wiped out losses on Wednesday afternoon as rumours swept financial markets that Russian President Boris Yeltsin had died.

November Brent rose to a high of $24.62 a barrel, just below Tuesday's post-Gulf War high of $24.70, but slipped when Yeltsin's spokesman said the president was working at his sanatorium outside Moscow.
By 1515 GMT Brent was off seven cents at $24.50 a barrel.
October gas oil was down $2 at $245 a tonne.
The November Brent/gas oil crack spread was at a weaker $7.45 a barrel. --London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
